body.en: Brand Fracture/Agony, Rift Disperse, Shattering, Rapacity

Olga's main gimmick is her 2 Brands, Fracture and Agony
Brands are a buff that Olga applies to herself
Brands trigger whenever Agony and or Fracture Activate
Activations can be from Forced (Cards) or Naturally (Turn End)
The turn end Moved Rift/Disperse stays in hand beginning of the next turn
Brand Fracture moves Disperse which Activates Agony
Brand Agony moves Rift which Activates Fracture
When Brands move a card they'll also be -1 Cost
Shattering is a Unique Debuff that End of the Line (EOTL) Applies
Enemies with Shattering take 1.3/1.4x damage from DoTs
(Enemies take DoT damage, then Shattering deals a% as Fixed)
Rapacity on EOTL and Reckoning
Cards with this Keyword turn the damage attribute into DoT

Lets go over a couple examples
2 Fracture Brand
2 Agony Brand
Rift -> Disperse -> Rift -> Disperse -> Rift or
Disperse -> Rift -> Disperse -> Rift -> Disperse
Now lets change up the timing of when you apply the Brands
Draw Rift & Disperse
Rift/Disperse
2 Fracture Brand
2 Agony Brand
Rift/Disperse -> Chain move x4
